alert.title: The Alert

shots.say: Would you survive the night?
At midnight, every phone in the city buzzed at once.
Stay inside. Lock your door. And do not make a sound.
Outside, something is walking. Very. Slowly.
You turn off every light.
Then your stomach growls. Really loud.
Every zombie on the street stops, and looks up at your window.
Do you hide under the bed, or run for the roof?

stairs.title: The Stairs

shots.say: If you picked B, this one is for you.
Knock. Knock. Knock.
You sneak out the back. The hallway light is flickering.
Twelve floors. No elevator. Run!
On floor ten, you hear footsteps, right below you.
The roof door. Is. Locked.
Do you break the door, or climb the pipe?

roof.title: The Roof

shots.say: If you picked B, you climbed the pipe.
You pull yourself onto the roof. The whole city is dark.
Then a light sweeps across the sky. A helicopter!
But the zombies hear it too.
The roof door starts to shake.
Do you wave for the helicopter, or hide behind the water tank?

twist.title: The Twist

shots.say: Everyone who waved: the helicopter saw you.
A rope drops down. You grab it and hold on tight.
Below you, the zombies all stop, and start to dance?
Wait. Was it all a giant zombie dance party?
Your phone buzzes one last time.
Should we make season two? Comment yes or no!

season2.title: Season 2

shots.say: Season two. The helicopter lands on a new roof.
The pilot yells: they only dance while the music plays!
Down below, the zombies are dancing. For now.
Then your phone buzzes. Five percent battery.
The music skips. Every zombie freezes.
Do you find a charger, or find a radio?

radio.title: The Radio

shots.say: If you picked B, you went looking for a radio.
The hallway is dark. Something is standing at the end.
A sign says: radio room. You slowly open the door.
There's an old radio! You turn the dial.
Static. Nothing but static.
Outside, the zombies stop dancing, and turn toward you.
Do you sing really loud, or bang on pots and pans?

song.title: The Song

shots.say: If you picked A, you started singing.
You sing as loud as you can. They start dancing again!
Then your phone rings. Unknown number.
A voice says: get to the roof. We are coming back.
Twenty-one floors. Keep singing. Don't stop!
On floor eighteen, you run out of breath.
Do you keep running, or hum really quietly?

finale2.title: The Rescue

shots.say: If you picked A, you kept running.
The roof door. Locked. Again?!
Then, a knock. From the other side.
The door swings open. The pilot throws you a rope!
Below you, every zombie waves goodbye, and keeps dancing.
Your phone buzzes one last time. Season three?
Should we make season three? Comment yes or no!
